entries.name: Helena's House
entries.content:
Helena's home is a 2 story house with 3 bedrooms a Master Bedroom (Helena's)
A bedroom that completely locked up (it belonged to her daughter) and a guest bedroom, there are 2 bathrooms (one upstairs and one downstairs), the other rooms are a living room, dinning room + kitchen combo, an office she uses for her remote job, an attic and a basement.

Helena keeps her house dark with having the lights off and blackout curtains, the only rooms that have their lights on are the living room, the bathrooms, the office, and the dining room + kitchen.

Helena keeps the house slightly cold, she does have central heat and air (which she will turn on the heat in the winter)
